brief: Holds a database schema as entities, keys and relations, draws it in crow's-foot notation and checks its rules about keys.
detail: An entity is a box with a name band and a compartment of attributes shown as PK, FK and plain columns; a relation is an undirected line whose ends carry the cardinality. Relate reads the kind from the first entity: OneToMany, ManyToOne, OneToOne or ManyToMany. Four rules judge the schema through GovernanceFindings: every entity declares a primary key, every foreign key names an entity of the diagram, every relation is backed by a foreign key (a junction for a many-to-many), and a participation declared at a key's target end agrees with the column's nullability. A note is drawn but is not an entity and owes no key. Weak entities, inheritance and Chen's diamonds are not here. ToCanvasXT draws the diagram.
receiver:
o1 = new stzErDiagram("shop")
o1.AddEntity("customer", "Customer")
o1.AddKey("customer", "id")
o1.AddEntity("order", "Order")
o1.AddKey("order", "id")
o1.AddForeignKey("order", "customer_id", "customer")
